design.title: ReconPro v7.2.3 — Launch Deck
design.reference: Matrix meets Kali Linux terminal — neon green on pure black with red danger accents

slides.title: Cover
slides.task_brief: COVER SLIDE — Impact launch cover. Massive title 'RECONPRO' in Space Mono, font-size 72px, with neon green text-shadow glow. Subtitle: 'The Most Dangerous Open-Source Recon Tool on the Planet' in Inter, color var(--text-dim). Version badge: 'v7.2.3' in a mono badge. Below that: 'pip install reconpro' in a terminal-style code block with dark bg (#111) and green text. Bottom tagline in small mono: '14 modules · 33 commands · 6 integrations · 7 compliance frameworks · Cross-platform'. Add a faint scanline overlay across the slide for hacker aesthetic. The hero image URL: https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/a7c1a9ba70f5.jpg — use as a semi-transparent background layer (opacity 0.15) behind the text. Speaker notes: full script (~120 words) — open with a hook about how every minute a company gets breached, introduce ReconPro as the free open-source weapon for defenders, mention it's on PyPI and anyone can install it with one command.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief: PROBLEM SLIDE — Left side (60%): Title 'THE THREAT IS EVOLVING. YOUR TOOLS AREN'T.' in Space Mono, white. Body text in Inter: 'The average time to detect a breach is 207 days. Attackers use APTs, zero-days, and supply chain attacks while defenders juggle 10+ disconnected tools, manual checklists, and alert fatigue. No single platform unifies recon, vulnerability scanning, threat hunting, and compliance — until now.' Three stat blocks stacked: '207 days' (large green number, mono), '10+ tools' (large red number, mono), '$4.45M avg breach cost' (large cyan number, mono). Right side (40%): Use image https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/c7fbe6a5f1c1.jpg as a dark atmospheric visual. Speaker notes: full script — paint the picture of overwhelmed security teams, cite the 207-day stat from IBM, explain alert fatigue, and set up ReconPro as the unified answer.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.task_brief: SOLUTION SLIDE — Center-heavy layout. Title: 'ONE TOOL. ZERO COMPROMISE.' in massive Space Mono (56px), white with green glow. Below, a single powerful statement in Inter: 'ReconPro is a free, open-source security reconnaissance platform with 14 integrated scan modules, 6 enterprise integrations, 7 compliance frameworks, and 33 CLI commands — all in a single pip install. No SaaS. No subscription. No limits.' Three feature pills below: '14 Modules' (green border), 'Cross-Platform' (cyan border), '100% Free & Open Source' (green border). Bottom: terminal-style command block: '$ pip install reconpro && reconpro scan --target your-domain.com'. Speaker notes: full script — emphasize that ReconPro replaces 10+ tools, it's completely free, no vendor lock-in, one command to install and scan.

slides.title: Section: Scan Engine
slides.task_brief: SECTION DIVIDER — Minimal, dramatic. Large green '01' in Space Mono (120px, very faded opacity 0.15) as background element. Chapter label in small mono uppercase: 'CHAPTER 01'. Title: 'THE SCAN ENGINE' in Space Mono 48px white. Tagline below: 'Three flagship modules. Zero mercy for threats.' in var(--text-dim) Inter. A thin horizontal green line (2px) separator below. Speaker notes: full script — transition into the deep-dive of the three flagship modules: GORGON, OBLIVION, and PEGASUS.

slides.title: GORGON ULTRA
slides.task_brief: GORGON ULTRA FEATURE SLIDE — Title: 'GORGON ULTRA' in Space Mono, green glow. Badge next to it: '15-STAGE THREAT ANALYSIS'. Left column: Describe GORGON — 'GORGON ULTRA is ReconPro's flagship threat assessment engine. It runs 15 sequential analysis stages: fingerprint → tech detect → port scan → TLS audit → DNS recon → SSL check → cookie analysis → header audit → info leak → vuln probe → XSS test → SQLi test → RCE test → config audit → final synthesis. Each stage feeds into the Fear Index.' Right column: Fear Index levels shown as stacked horizontal bars, each with distinct color — SUBTLE (green), NOTABLE (yellow), ALARMING (orange), DEVASTATING (red), OMNIPOTENT (bright red with glow). Each bar gets progressively wider. Bottom: 'The Fear Index quantifies your threat level on a scale from subtle to omnipotent. No other open-source tool does this.' Speaker notes: full script — explain each stage briefly, focus on the Fear Index as a unique differentiator, how it synthesizes 15 tests into one score.

slides.title: OBLIVION
slides.task_brief: OBLIVION FEATURE SLIDE — Title: 'OBLIVION' in Space Mono, red glow. Badge: '20-STAGE DEEP VULNERABILITY SCANNER'. Layout: Two-column. Left: Description — 'OBLIVION is the deep vulnerability scanner that goes where standard tools fear to tread. 20 analysis stages including SQL injection probing, XSS hunting, SSRF chain exploitation, path traversal detection, and more. Every finding is scored on the DREAD scale.' Right: DREAD levels shown as vertical progression — Info (gray), Low (green), Medium (yellow), High (orange), Critical (red), TRANSCENDENT (bright red with glow, unique to OBLIVION). Below DREAD: Two unique features in accent-bordered cards: 'Wisdom Verdict' — AI-powered summary of your security posture, and 'Mirror Fracture' — attack surface decomposition showing how vulnerabilities chain together. Speaker notes: full script — explain the 20 stages, introduce DREAD as the scoring system, highlight TRANSCENDENT as a level above critical that only OBLIVION uses, describe Wisdom Verdict and Mirror Fracture as unique features.

slides.title: PEGASUS HUNTER
slides.task_brief: PEGASUS HUNTER FEATURE SLIDE — Title: 'PEGASUS HUNTER' in Space Mono, cyan glow. Badge: 'ADVANCED SPYWARE DETECTION'. Left side (55%): Description — 'PEGASUS HUNTER detects the world's most sophisticated spyware and APT indicators. It scans for 135 known C2 domains used by Pegasus, Hermit Worm, and similar nation-state malware. It checks 11 SMS attack patterns, 19 suspicious process signatures, and 9 filesystem path indicators.' Four stat blocks in a 2x2 grid: '135 C2 Domains' (green mono), '11 SMS Patterns' (green mono), '19 Process Signatures' (green mono), '9 Path Indicators' (green mono). Right side (45%): Use image https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/7a90126b05ea.jpg with dark overlay. Bottom warning banner: 'PEGASUS HUNTER is not a toy. These indicators track real threats used against journalists and activists.' in red mono. Speaker notes: full script — explain the real-world context of Pegasus spyware, mention that this module helps defenders and researchers detect surveillance, cite the 135 C2 domains as a curated threat intelligence database.

slides.title: Section: Ecosystem
slides.task_brief: SECTION DIVIDER — Minimal, dramatic. Large green '02' in Space Mono (120px, very faded opacity 0.15) as background element. Chapter label: 'CHAPTER 02'. Title: 'THE ECOSYSTEM' in Space Mono 48px white. Tagline: 'Modules, integrations, and compliance — all wired together.' in var(--text-dim). A thin horizontal green line separator below. Speaker notes: full script — transition into the broader ecosystem: all 14 modules, 6 integrations, 7 compliance frameworks.

slides.title: 14 Scan Modules
slides.task_brief: 14 MODULES BENTO GRID — Title: '14 SCAN MODULES. ONE UNIFIED PLATFORM.' in Space Mono white. A 4x4 bento grid (some tiles span 2 columns) showing all 14 modules with icon, name, and one-line description. The modules: recon (Reconnaissance engine), vibesec (Vibe security analysis), auth (Authentication auditing), chain (Attack chain mapping), bot (Botnet detection — Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Emotet, TrickBot, QakBot, SolarWinds, Log4Shell), gorgon (GORGON ULTRA threat engine), oblivion (OBLIVION deep scanner), nhi (Network host intelligence), host (Host system audit), dev (Developer security tools), doctor (System diagnostics), cloud_recon (Cloud infrastructure recon), pegasus (PEGASUS spyware hunter), team (Team management). Color-code: flagship modules (gorgon, oblivion, pegasus) get green borders, standard modules get dim gray borders. Each tile: dark bg (#111), module name in mono, description in small Inter. Speaker notes: full script — walk through the categories: recon is the core, gorgon/oblivion/pegasus are flagship, bot detects specific malware, cloud_recon hits AWS/Azure/GCP, team manages your crew.

slides.title: 6 Integrations
slides.task_brief: INTEGRATIONS SLIDE — Title: '6 ENTERPRISE INTEGRATIONS. ZERO CONFIG HEADACHES.' in Space Mono white. Layout: 6 integration cards in a 3x2 grid. Each card shows: Integration name (mono, green), description (1 line, Inter), and the protocol/type. The integrations: 1) Jira — Auto-create tickets from findings (REST API), 2) Slack — Real-time alerts to channels (Webhook), 3) GitHub — Push security reports to repos (REST API), 4) Splunk — Forward findings to SIEM (HEC/REST), 5) PagerDuty — Trigger incident escalation (Events API), 6) Z.AI — SSE streaming with AI analysis (Server-Sent Events). Each card has a dark bg with a subtle green left-border accent. Bottom: 'All integrations use standard protocols. No proprietary agents needed.' in mono dim. Speaker notes: full script — explain that ReconPro plugs into existing workflows, not replaces them. Walk through each integration briefly.

slides.title: 7 Compliance Frameworks
slides.task_brief: COMPLIANCE SLIDE — Title: '7 COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORKS. MAPPED AUTOMATICALLY.' in Space Mono white. Use image https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/e7db5e79a605.jpg as a subtle background element (opacity 0.1). Main content: 7 framework badges/cards arranged in a clean layout. Each shows the framework name and what it covers: SOC2 (Trust Service Criteria), ISO 27001 (Information Security Management), PCI-DSS (Payment Card Data Security), HIPAA (Health Information Privacy), GDPR (Data Protection Regulation), CIS Controls (Center for Internet Security), NIST CSF (Cybersecurity Framework). Below the frameworks: 'ReconPro's ComplianceMapper automatically maps every finding to relevant framework controls. Run a scan, get a compliance report. No manual cross-referencing.' in Inter. Speaker notes: full script — explain that compliance is usually a nightmare of spreadsheets, ReconPro automates mapping findings to controls for 7 major frameworks.

slides.title: Section: Platform
slides.task_brief: SECTION DIVIDER — Large green '03' faded background. Chapter label: 'CHAPTER 03'. Title: 'THE PLATFORM' in Space Mono 48px white. Tagline: '33 commands. 3 operating systems. Zero friction.' in var(--text-dim). Thin green line separator. Speaker notes: full script — transition to the platform details: CLI power, cross-platform support, how to get started.

slides.title: 33 CLI Commands
slides.task_brief: CLI COMMANDS SLIDE — Title: '33 COMMANDS. INFINITE POWER.' in Space Mono, green glow. Layout: Terminal-style showcase. A large dark terminal window (bg #111, border green) showing sample commands in green mono text. Show these commands grouped: Core: 'reconpro scan --target example.com', 'reconpro scan --modules gorgon,oblivion', 'reconpro report --format json'. Modules: 'reconpro gorgon --target example.com', 'reconpro oblivion --url https://example.com', 'reconpro pegasus --full-scan'. Team: 'reconpro team add @hacker --role lead', 'reconpro team list'. Integrations: 'reconpro integrations slack --channel #alerts'. Utilities: 'reconpro doctor --check-all', 'reconpro export --format pdf'. Below terminal: 'Every command has --help. Every module can run standalone or combined.' in dim mono. Speaker notes: full script — demonstrate the CLI philosophy, show how intuitive the commands are, emphasize that each module runs independently.

slides.title: Cross-Platform
slides.task_brief: CROSS-PLATFORM SLIDE — Title: 'WORKS EVERYWHERE. PERIOD.' in Space Mono white. Layout: Three columns, each representing an OS — Windows, Linux, macOS. Each column has: OS icon (use Material Icons: 'desktop_windows' for Windows, 'terminal' for Linux, 'laptop_mac' for macOS), OS name in large mono, and the same install command below each: 'pip install reconpro'. Below all three columns: Three check badges in green: 'Pure Python (zero compiled dependencies)', 'py3-none-any wheel (universal)', 'Tested on Windows 10/11, Ubuntu/Debian, macOS'. Bottom: 'One codebase. Every platform. No compatibility hacks.' in dim mono. Speaker notes: full script — explain the cross-platform story, how we fixed os.uname() crashes on Windows, the pure Python architecture means no C extensions to break.

slides.title: Install & Go
slides.task_brief: INSTALL SLIDE — Title: 'START HUNTING IN 30 SECONDS.' in Space Mono, green glow. Center layout with a massive terminal-style code block: 'pip install reconpro' (large green mono on #111 bg, with a blinking cursor effect via CSS animation). Below: Two-column quick start — Left: 'Scan a target': 'reconpro scan --target your-domain.com'. Right: 'Run GORGON ULTRA': 'reconpro gorgon --target your-domain.com'. Bottom: Three pillars in green-bordered cards: 'Free Forever' (No SaaS, no subscription, MIT license), 'Open Source' (Community driven, transparent code), 'Zero Dependencies' (Pure Python, no compiled libs). Speaker notes: full script — walk through the install process live, emphasize the speed of getting started, mention the MIT license and that contributions are welcome.

slides.title: Closing CTA
slides.task_brief: CLOSING SLIDE — Dark, dramatic, minimal. Center: Large 'RECONPRO' in Space Mono 72px with intense green glow. Below: 'The future of recon is open. The future is now.' in Inter, white. Terminal command in large mono: 'pip install reconpro' with green text on #111 bg. Below that: 'GitHub: github.com/your-org/reconpro' and 'PyPI: pypi.org/project/reconpro' in dim mono. Bottom tagline: 'Built by defenders. For defenders. Always free.' in small dim mono. A faint scanline overlay. Speaker notes: full script — closing energy, repeat the pip install command, invite people to star the repo, contribute, and join the community. End with 'Stay dangerous, stay secure.'
